item.text: The recorded baseline points to repeated self-checking, rather than incorrect arithmetic, as the main failure mode. However, suppressing layer 23’s neuron 22 did not improve paired accuracy, so its high activation is not enough to justify an edit. The kernel has restarted and the notes do not cover all six completed passes, so I will first recover those results and inspect the saved-data formats. This will prevent repeating unsuccessful interventions and identify what evidence is still available for causal localization.
